title: ux.game_speed_assist_changed
description: Emitted when settings.game_speed_assist transitions between Off / Slowdown75 / Slowdown25 / FullPause. The per-tick scheduler in cf-control's drive_tick reads game_speed_assist and skips ticks deterministically (tick-counter modulo arithmetic) so 75% / 25% / 0% sim-speed pacing is replay-stable. Multiplayer sessions ignore game_speed_assist (single-player only).
